stories.title: Australia Test captain Pat Cummins calls Khawaja's sandpapergate claims ‘complete and utter nonsense’
summary: Cummins insists he did not know of ball-tampering plot in South Africa‘No masterplan around using illegal methods,’ Cummins says‘Abrasive’, ‘arrogant’ and ‘ugly’: standout moments from the press conferencePat Cummins flatly denied Usman Khawaja’s claims that the entire Australian cricket team was implicated in the 2018 sandpaper scandal, saying at a press conference in Sydney the allegations were “complete and utter nonsense”and “100% wrong”.The Test captain’s defiant appearance on Friday morning prompted David Warner to later accuse Cummins of throwing Khawaja under the bus as the feud engulfing Australian cricket continued.

stories.title: Pegula saves match point to reach WTA Finals semi-finals as Gauff exits
summary: American saves match point in 7-6, 4-6, 7-5 victoryPegula advances as compatriot Gauff is eliminatedHot-mic controversy adds spice to Andreeva semiJessica Pegula saved a match point en route to a gritty 7-6 (7-2), 4-6, 7-5 win over Linda Noskova on Thursday to advance from her round-robin group at the WTA Finals and send fellow American Coco Gauff packing from the season-ending championships.Pegula hit a career-high 16 aces while Wimbledon champion Noskova committed a career-high 15 double faults in a see-saw battle that lasted two hours and 45 minutes at the tournament, which was moved from Riyadh to Indian Wells because of the US-Israeli war on Iran.

stories.title: Harry Kane spot on to seal England win over Croatia on his record-breaking night
summary: It was an historic occasion for Harry Kane, the one when he made his 126th England appearance and overtook Peter Shilton as the nation’s most capped men’s player.

The actual football in this Nations League group game felt like a sideshow.England had demolished Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka last month; it was Croatia’s heaviest defeat.
